description: The ways the government buys: contract vehicles from the verified award records, with who holds them, the agency, industry and set-aside, status (open, expired, cancelled, terminated, closed out), the ordering-period end, and their history (new, extensions, ceiling changes, options, cancellations, corrections). Pass vehicle_key for one vehicle with the orders placed on it, or search by query words, ticker (verified contractor IDs only), uei, agency, status=open|closed or ending_before. MONEY IS KEPT APART: ceiling is the most that may be ordered, NEVER money awarded or obligated, and ceilings must never be added together (multiple-award vehicles repeat one program ceiling for every awardee); obligated_on_orders is money actually obligated on orders placed on the vehicle in verified years; remaining_capacity is null unless it can be stated soundly (single-award vehicle, whole order history held). Quote these labels when you summarise.

ending_before.description: ISO date; vehicles whose ordering period ends on or before it (recompetes)

query.description: Words in the vehicle description, program name, holder or industry

ticker.description: Holder ticker; matched through verified contractor IDs only
